{{Top}} {{Otheruses|unidentified bounty hunter}} {{Conjecture}} {{Character |type=Bounty hunter |image=[[File:DustBreather.png]] |name=Unidentified bounty hunter |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=A [[Unidentified dust-breathing species|dust-breathing species]]{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 3: The Sin}} |gender= |pronouns= |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes= |skin= |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=[[Bounty Hunters' Guild]] |masters= |apprentices= }} A '''bounty hunter''' was a part of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild]] by [[9 ABY]]. After the [[Hunting|hunter]] failed to capture a target, the [[bounty hunter]] was refused more [[holopuck]]s by the Guild agent [[Greef Karga]]. When the [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty]] [[Hunting|hunter]] [[Din Djarin]] rescued the creature known as "[[Din Grogu|the Child]]," the [[bounty]] hunter joined Karga and a number of other bounty hunters in attempting to stop the Mandalorian, but were unsuccessful. ==Biography== {{Quote|Look, I told you I'm not interested in your excuses!''"
[the bounty hunter speaks Huttese]
"''You had your shot, dust breather, but you failed. No pucks for you. Now get outta here.''"
[the bounty hunter speaks Huttese]"''|Greef Karga and the bounty hunter|audio=SaucerHeadExcuses-TMS01CH03.flac|}} The bounty hunter later joined the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild]]. Around [[9 ABY]], the [[bounty hunter]] was present at the [[Nevarro school|cantina]] on the [[planet]] [[Nevarro]] where the [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty]] [[Hunting|hunter]] [[Din Djarin]] claimed a bounty from [[Greef Karga]], a Guild agent.{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 1: The Mandalorian}} Sometime later, he took on a bounty from Karga but failed to capture the target, later arguing and attempting to justify his failure with the agent, but was ultimately refused when he demanded for more [[holopuck]]s. [[File:Bounty_Hunters_Surround_The_Mandalorian.png|thumb|right|250px|The bounty hunter and the Bounty Hunters' Guild surrounded the Mandalorian.]] After the Mandalorian [[Incident on Nevarro|rescued]] a creature known as "[[Din Grogu|the Child]]," the bounty hunter noticed that their [[tracking fob]] was activated alongside several other hunters' fobs when the Child was in the vicinity. Under Karga's command, the Guild slowly surrounded the Mandalorian as he attempted to escape in his [[starship]], the ''[[Razor Crest]]''. When he began firing at the hunters, the bounty hunter and the Guild engaged the Mandalorian and attempted to reclaim the Child. The bounty hunters took cover when the Mandalorian began using his [[Amban phase-pulse blaster]]. the bounty hunter hid behind a stack of crates, but began approaching his position with the other bounty hunters. The Guild's efforts were thwarted when a [[The Tribe|tribe]] of Mandalorians arrived and helped the Mandalorian escape. ==Personality and traits== The bounty hunter spoke [[huttese]]. The hunter was furious when arguing with Karga over the failure of a bounty, attempting to justify it and demanding more pucks. ==Equipment== The bounty hunter used a [[blaster pistol]] while in the Bounty Hunters' Guild. ==Behind the scenes== The bounty hunter first appeared in the [[Chapter 1: The Mandalorian|first episode]] of [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[2019]] [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', which aired on [[November 12]], 2019.{{WebCite|url=https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_project_one-sheet_10_ec1e005f.pdf|text=The Mandalorian Media Kit|date=2019-09-24|format=[[Wikipedia:PDF|PDF]]|work=[[Wikipedia:Walt Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International|Walt Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International]]|pages=[https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_project_one-sheet_10_ec1e005f.pdf#page=1 p. 1]|archivedate=20210623202717}} The character's costume was repurposed from "[[Saucer Head]],"{{Topps|set=2018 Topps Solo: A Star Wars Story|cardname=Saucer Head|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/176424/cid/11326611}} a character from the [[2018]] ''[[Star Wars Anthology Series]]'' film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''.''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' ==Appearances== *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 1: The Mandalorian}} *''[[The Mandalorian: Season 1: Volume 1]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian: The Manga]]'' *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 3: The Sin}} ==Sources== *{{DisneyGallery|Directing}} *{{DisneyGallery|Legacy}} *{{DisneyGallery|Cast}} *{{DisneyGallery|Process}} *{{DisneyGallery|Score}} *{{DisneyGallery|Connections}} *{{InsiderCite|209|Crime and Punishment}} {{Imo}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=უცნობი ჯილდოზე მონადირე (გრიფ კარგა) }} [[Category:Bounty Hunters' Guild bounty hunters]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified species]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
